title: Dog Night, from behind
logline: November 15. The dumpster behind the Lanes. A man's back, a three-legged dog beside him, the sign above with most letters dark. Twenty-two years. No caption. The first Dog Night with no strip to be in.

panels.composition: The alley behind the Lanes at night. The dumpster, exact. A man from behind in the blue plaid flannel, hands in pockets, and a small three-legged dog sitting beside his boot, both facing the dumpster. Above the roofline, the sign, most tubes dark. Rain starting. No caption. No text anywhere.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a night alley behind a bowling alley with a dumpster drawn precisely, a man seen from behind in blue plaid flannel with hands in pockets and a small three-legged dog sitting beside his boot both facing the dumpster, a neon sign with most letters dark above the roofline, rain beginning, no words
image.notes: No caption. The public strip always captioned the Dog Night with the count; the private page doesn't.

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: The first Dog Night with nowhere to run. Uncaptioned.
